development: A 545 kt/yr propylene oxide unit in Pasadena, Texas is down and is holding back polyether polyol
context: Buyers were worried there would not be enough polyol to meet demand, which would cap MDI and TDI demand with it. The owner said on 1 May it aimed to restart by the end of the second quarter.
internal_note: Isocyanate market letter, 6 May 2026, US market commentary
